s: E-LANE E-6 walk_e6: one-kick chain with the walked fuel-fed epilogue

E-LANE E-6 chain walk_e6: ONE fmt=1 walk, ONE KICK = SCORE + PV + OPROJ(FUEL-FED, o8 EPILOGUE ON-TILE) + RES1 + NFEED (toy 64, H=1, T=1). The o-projection's product lands in the residual row THROUGH ser->deq->residual and THAT row feeds the norm — the epilogue's activation never leaves the tile. Host in the walk window: NOTHING.
phase A: CSR sanity + illegal-descriptor reject + tier init
INFO_TIER expect retargeted 0x7->0x1 (image b64_05b: KVQ_OUTLIER_K=0, KVQ_GQA_NENG=2 -> CQ-8-only; apex_top.sv:2540-2543). Jobs are CQ-8; NO datapath expectation touched.
loader token: h8=[127,1,0...] via real RMSNorm+feeder

[1] host loads: phase-q table; K/V records; X; the o-act family (the PV o8 codes) at act bank1 ROW 1 (fp_oproj_base); then PRE-STAGES the rotated-q row at ROW 0 through the q_sink (the l3 walker-mode idiom — staging rides the mailbox xw stream, which the fuel arm below DISCONNECTS, so it must all happen first).
inject K/V fp16 rows through squant MODE_F16 -> KVQ (CQ-8)
(a) the o-act staging -> bank1 row 1 (counted ess = the row's own C-1 scale; the stored codes are quant(o8 vals))
(b) the rotated-q staging -> bank1 row 0 (rope-q + q_sink; fs cap = the staged row's C-1 scale; then the q_sink restore)
FUELARM-SPLICE-POINT
IB-FUEL arm: mode only (src=1, ar_owner=1). The walker issues the records itself.
[2] the 64-word fmt=1 image: mask {SCORE, PV, OPROJ, RES1, NFEED, NSRC, FPROJ} + Wo base + RQ[1] + JC[OPROJ] — the whole chain in one image; FMT_SUP check first
[3] THE ONE KICK — and NOTHING else: no xw pacing (q was pre-staged), no RO drain (the epilogue's o8' never reaches the RO FIFO). The next host op is the completion poll.
CYCMARK e6go
SILICON DBG PROBE: wait for ESTK, read frame-vs-stale
CYCMARK e6done
FUELDISARM-SPLICE-POINT
IB-FUEL disarm: src back to MAILBOX (reader idle, FIFO empty — the walk consumed its records whole)
epilogue consumers drained CLEAN; no LAYER error
[3b] the level word the WALKER left: LVLO's ser_dst=1 + resid_arm + rope re-arm (bank 0), then NFEED's code-4 + nsrc=1 — LAYER_CTRL[19] set by the SEQUENCER. Full-word check.
[4] drain the walk's egress in FIFO order: 1 ss (s_c), 10 fs (s_k, 8x s_v, the NFEED r1 scale — the q scale was capped at staging), 8 RO beats (the PV o8), the TIP beat
[5] gamma releases the norm's emission — but the row it normed is r1, THE WALKED EPILOGUE'S PRODUCT: h2 scale + codes, then the r1 row itself via LAYER_RDATA
quiescence + LAYER error accounting (no unit may have refused: LAYER_STATUS[8] sticky must be clear)
final: quiescence + sticky accounting + PERF + F-3 clear
